caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wrought iron gate or grille with intricate decorative designs, rendered in monochromatic black on a light beige background. The composition is symmetrical, with three vertical sections separated by two straight bars. The central section features a lyre-shaped motif surrounded by swirling acanthus leaves and scrollwork. The top of the gate has a decorative crest with more scrollwork and floral elements forming a triangular pediment. The side panels are adorned with vertical arrangements of baluster-like forms and leafy ornamentation. The entire structure is detailed with curvilinear patterns and florid embellishments. Below the drawing, the name "Charlotte Angus" is printed in small capital letters.
title: Gate to Cemetery Plot
